name: portal
description: Official Spotify Portal plugin marketplace for AI coding tools.

plugins.name: portal
plugins.description: Set up, diagnose, search, and operate Spotify Portal through focused Portal CLI workflows.

plugins.name: shunt
plugins.description: Shunts I/O-heavy work to AiKA modes to save tokens. Hooks block large file reads and redirect to bulk-reader/code-writer scripts backed by the Portal CLI.

plugins.name: shunt-local
plugins.description: Shunts I/O-heavy work to cheaper local subagents. A hook denies large file reads on the main thread and redirects to a haiku bulk-reader agent; a sonnet code-writer agent generates boilerplate to disk. No Portal CLI needed.
